relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN — REPORT LOUDLY. This row was seeded to 'wald1984', whose registered entry is a general-relativity textbook that is not on arXiv at all. The attached file is a single-author arXiv preprint, id 1910.09966v1, filed under physics.gen-ph, on modelling elementary particles by braids and 3-manifolds. No plausible relation to the id. I searched folio/schema/references.ts by author surname, preprint id and subject: no matching id exists, so id is set to null and the document needs its own ref() entry. RELEVANCE: unusually well-targeted at this corpus. It models fermions as hyperbolic knot complements and bosons as torus bundles, presents knot complements as 3-fold branched covers of a 3-disk branched along 3-braids, derives electric charge from topology, uses Drinfeld-Turaev quantization so that quantum states correspond to knots, and explicitly connects to the octonionic/quaternionic division-algebra models and to the braid-preon model. The corpus already registers both the braid-preon reference and the division-algebra thesis; this is the document that joins those two threads to hyperbolic-knot-complement fermions, which is QOU's own picture. HONEST CAVEAT: it is posted to the arXiv general-physics category, which carries no peer-review signal; it should be cited as a literature parallel, not as authority.

keyResults.statement: Fermions are modelled as hyperbolic knot complements S^3 minus (K x D^2) and bosons as torus bundles; knot complements are presented as 3-fold branched covers of the 3-disk branched along 3-braids, with electric charge obtained from topology and the correct spectrum of possible values.
keyResults.useForFolio: A published parallel to the braid-to-fermion assignment underlying conj:sm-gauge-truncation and rem:breit-wheeler-vertex-literature, and the explicit bridge between the braid-preon and division-algebra routes the corpus registers separately.
